hook: California Schemin brings fake American personas to the big screen.

sections.voiceover: California Schemin brings fake American personas to the big screen.
On October 9, 2026, the film California Schemin hit theaters nationwide. Magenta Light Studios greenlit the production earlier that April. How long has McAvoy planned this directorial shift?
Magenta Light Studios set this release after McAvoy pondered directing since age 16.
Now, McAvoy delivers his feature debut through Patriot Pictures. This R-rated project spans a 107-minute runtime. It explores the true story of Scottish rappers faking American personas.
Catch California Schemin in theaters now.
